race.title: NFU Mutual Agriculture Raceday Novices' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: THIS SWAY was in good form in the spring and can make a winning seasonal return. Stylia has undergone an interesting stable switch and looks on a competitive mark if still retaining her ability after an 18-month absence, whilst Teofimo was seen to maximum effect when scoring at Newcastle last week but is clearly on decent terms with himself. THIS SWAY STYLIA (FR) TEOFIMO (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Teofimo (15/8), This Sway (5/2), Bouboule (9/2), Stylia (5/1), Toby Two Scoops (10/1), C'Est Pour Moi (20/1)
